message: bridge-deduction-b-wrong: a fresh game. All twelve facts are granted from the console with grantFact: exercised, not earned. Name Lindqvist only, then close.

fn:
async () => { /* W1 grant every fact from the console; every suspect decidable */ window.__toasts = window.__toasts || []; if (!window.__toastSpy) { const orig = window.gameAlert; window.gameAlert = (...a) => { window.__toasts.push(a); return orig ? orig(...a) : undefined; }; window.__toastSpy = true; } const facts = ['b_okoro_access','b_lindqvist_access','b_haddad_access','b_morgan_access','b_okoro_device','b_lindqvist_device','b_haddad_device','b_morgan_device','b_okoro_grievance','b_lindqvist_grievance','b_haddad_grievance','b_morgan_grievance']; for (const f of facts) window.deductionRuntime.grantFact(f, { source: 'bridge' });
  const S = window.deductionRuntime.getState(); return Object.values(S.decidable).every(v => v === true) && S.truth.ded_b_okoro === 'guilty'; }

async () => { /* open the phone and Nair's thread (outline) */ const ph = window.inventory.items.find(i => i.scenarioData && i.scenarioData.phoneId === 'player_phone'); if (!ph) return false; window.handleObjectInteraction(ph); return true; }

async () => { /* W2 Nair's reply reads the outcome globals written at close */ const d = window.__test.minigame && window.__test.minigame.getState(); return /doesn't sit right/.test(JSON.stringify(d || {})); }
